tenderSchedule.title: Providing Wooden wardrobes, storage space for vehicle spare parts at vehicle supervisors room, fabrication works opal sheet works and other allied works at LH 4 Bengaluru.

tenderSchedule.locationName: PWD No.1 Buildings Division Office Bengaluru

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
The intending tenderer is instructed to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-1 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.
All necessary drawings, paper works, etc. and any other formalities required to be observed shall be the responsibility of contractor
Whenever executing authority insist proof of having purchased the materials (used during executing the work) for verification. The contractor has to produce the purchase bills.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
Conditional tenders are not accepted.

The tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates, which shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
Financial year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and thirty first day of March inclusive
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all tender without assigning any reason.
Tenderer shall note, that the tenderers those found Eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers (ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E- procurement portal

All the items includes all Leads and Lifts, Loading and Unloading, transportation charges, Cost of all materials, Labour, HOM of machineries as per Standard specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work and all other incidental items which are necessary for the successful completion of the work
The bidder should Upload Valid KPWD Class IV and above Civil License. Civil Contractor with PWD, Govt. of Karnataka and should have suitable technical, financial & managerial capabilities
The contractor shall not deviate/alter/execute excess quantities or additional items without the prior approval
The Cost of the tender form shall not be refundable.
Further particulars, if any, required by the contractor can be had from the O/o the Executive Engineer, No.1 buildings Division during office hours.
Agency Should upload Employees provident fund (EPF) & ESI registration certificate, and also should upload copy of receipt of the last six months for the payment made for the same
The Tenderer should submit Latest GST clearance certificate
The quantities shown in the schedule are approximate. The actual quantities will be executed as per site condition only. Any balance materials shall be taken back by the contractor.
Tenderer should be registered in labour department & submit labour registration certificate
Tenderers must provide the address with valid proof of address along with latest photographs of all the employees who are employed in this work to the concerned authority
Tenderers must provide insurance to all the employees executing this work.
The Labours deployed shall mandatorily wear the face mask, hand gloves and take all safety measures to protect labours and staff

Bidder should upload the bid capacity calculated as per KW-1 tender condition, The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent. False representations in the statements leads to disqualification of the tender as per clause 3.1
The Quoted Rates Shall be Excluding GST

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2 To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 b)Satisfactory completion as prime contractor in Similar works to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work i.e. Rs 4.02 Lakhs

3.2 To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 a)Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs 8.04 lakhs

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.6.Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5- B) Where A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited 2 month. B is Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 2 month. Note The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent
The bidder should Upload Valid KPWD Class IV and above Civil License.

Bid Capacity Calculation as per KW Document
Workdone Certificate issued by not below rank of Executive Engineer

itemList.description:
Providing  and  supplying   19mm  thick  both  side  balancing  lamination factory pressed BWP grade marine ply as per IS 710 of approved brand bo xes,shelves,racks,almirah,cupboard and drawer etc. including necessary nails,screws etc. complete as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.
Note:  For  items  (1)  to  (7)  Minor  fittings  are  included  in  price  &  Major Fittings  to  be  paid  separately.  The  cost  is  excluding  cost  of  Labour  & installation charges)

Providing and supplying   cupboard shutter with 19mm thick one side Architect recommended decorative laminate (1mm thick) and other side balancing lamination(preferably white) on factory pressed bwp grade marine ply as per IS 710 of approved brand complete as per direction of   engineer  in-charge.(Payment  for  providing  and  fixing  auto  closing hinges shall be paid separately)
Note:  For  items  (1)  to  (7)  Minor  fittings  are  included  in  price  &  Major Fittings  to  be  paid  separately.  The  cost  is  excluding  cost  of  Labour  & installation charges)
Labour  &  installation  charges  for  BWP  ply:BWR  ply:HDHMR:  MDF  & Particle board work of any thickness applicable for all types of work
Providing and fixing stainless steel soft closing heavy type telescopic drawer  channels  of  approved  make  500  mm  long  with  screws  etc. complete as per directions of Engineer- in-charge.

Providing  and  fixing  Stainless  Steel  304  grade  soft  closing  spring hinges at 0 degree hinges (hydraulic type) of approved make/brand to cupboard shutters with full threaded steel screws including making necessary recess in board and finished etc. complete as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.
Providing and fixing stainless steel 304 grade fancy handle of approved make fixed with sS screws etc. complete as per direction of Engineer-in- charge. 200mm length
Providing and fixing stainless steel 304 grade fancy handle of approved make fixed with sS screws etc. complete as per direction of Engineer-in- charge. 150 mm length
Providing and fixing special quality bright finished brass cupboard or ward robe locks with four levers of approved quality including necessary screws etc. complete. - 50mm

Providing and fixing aluminium tower bolts, ISI marked, anodised (anodic coating not less than grade AC 10 as per IS : 1868 ) transparent or dyed to required colour or shade, with necessary screws etc. complete

Providing and fixing PTMT door catcher of length 72 mm and dia. of 42 mm
with suitable washers weighing not less than 33 gms

Providing and fixing   Steel work in built up tubular (round, square or rectangular  hollow  tubes  etc.)  trusses  etc.,  including  cutting,  hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer, including welding and bolted with special shaped washers etc. complete. Hot finished welded type tubes  including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing  and  fixing  6mm  Clear/opal  white/solar  bronze/blue/green tinted  Multi wall  poly carbonate sheet for Tubular structure. The work including  cost  of  all  materials,  labour  charges  and  usage  charges  of machinery for cutting, welding, grinding and erection equipments, with all  lead,  transportation,  loading  and  unloading  and  all  other  incidental charges etc. complete as per specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.

Repairing  and  fixing  shutters  (panelled  or  glazed)  to  doors,  windows,
ventilators and cupboards.

Removing white wash or colour wash by steel brushing and / or scraping, sand papering and preparing wall surface smooth including repairs to scraches including cost of labour, material complete as per specifications.

Providing  and  applying  white  cement  based  putty  of  average thickness 1  mm,  of   approved   brand   and   manufacturer,   over   the  plastered wall   surface   to prepare the surface even and smooth complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Finishing walls with 100% Premium acrylic emulsion paint having VOC less  than   50   g/L and   UV   resistance   as   per   IS 15489:2004,  Alkali &    fungal resistance, dirt resistance exterior paint   of   required   shade (Company  Depot  Tinted)  with  silicon additives, New work (Two coats applied  @  1.43  L/  10  m².  Over  and  including  priming  coat  of  exterior primer applied @ 0.90  L/10 m²  with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
